en.headline: DoJ welcomes NPCSC amendments regularising GBA lawyers scheme
en.dek: Amendments to the mainland Lawyers Law take effect on 1 September, giving dual-qualified Hong Kong lawyers a statutory basis to practise specified matters in nine Guangdong cities.
body: The Department of Justice on Saturday welcomed amendments to the Lawyers Law of the People's Republic of China passed by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on 28 August. The changes take effect on 1 September.

Article 62 provides that Hong Kong and Macao legal practitioners who pass the Greater Bay Area Legal Professional Examination organised by the State Council's judicial administration department, and obtain mainland practice qualification, may practise stipulated legal matters in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Foshan, Huizhou, Dongguan, Zhongshan, Jiangmen and Zhaoqing. Enrolment, application procedures and the scope of practice are to be set by that department.

The Department of Justice said the amendments supply the legal basis for regularising the GBA lawyers scheme, so that Hong Kong lawyers with dual qualifications can handle specified civil and commercial matters under mainland law in the nine municipalities. Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said the changes support the scheme's growth and align with the national outline for deepening Greater Bay Area development.

A three-year pilot authorised in August 2020 was due to expire in October 2023 and was later extended to 4 October 2026. As of June 2026, more than 650 Hong Kong and Macao lawyers had obtained the Lawyer's Licence (GBA) and appeared in court or handled arbitration in those cities. The department said it would stay in contact with the Ministry of Justice and the Guangdong Province Department of Justice on the regularised arrangement.

zh.headline: 律政司歡迎全國人大常委會修訂律師法 規範大灣區律師機制
zh.dek: 內地《律師法》修訂將於9月1日生效，為具備雙重資格的香港律師在廣東九市執業指定民商事法律事務提供法律依據。
body: 律政司周六歡迎全國人民代表大會常務委員會於8月28日通過《中華人民共和國律師法》修訂，有關修訂將於9月1日生效。
第62條訂明，通過國務院司法行政部門組織的粵港澳大灣區律師執業考試、取得內地執業資格的港澳法律執業者，可在廣州、深圳、珠海、佛山、惠州、東莞、中山、江門及肇慶執業指定法律事務。報考條件、申請程序及執業範圍由該部門規定。
律政司表示，修訂為大灣區律師機制常規化提供法律基礎，讓具備雙重資格的香港律師可在上述九市處理指定的內地民商事法律事務。律政司司長林定國表示，修訂有助機制發展，並配合國家深化大灣區建設的規劃。
全國人大常委會2020年8月授權為期三年的試點，原於2023年10月屆滿，其後延至2026年10月4日。截至2026年6月，逾650名港澳律師已取得「律師工作證（粵港澳大灣區）」，並曾在該九市出庭或處理仲裁。律政司表示會繼續與司法部及廣東省司法廳保持聯繫，配合常規化安排。
